```{python}
import pickle

import numpy as np
from IPython.display import display, Latex, Image
import sys
import pandas as pd
sys.path.append("../tools")
from allDirectionPlots import allDirectionPlots
#
patNum = "pat001"
pklPath = "K:/iowaExpTest/rigidMovement/moveSummaryData/" + patNum + "/mainResults.pkl"
imagePath = "K:/iowaExpTest/rigidMovement/moveSummaryData/" + patNum + "/rigidImage.png"
#load in data
with open(pklPath, "rb") as f:
    res = pickle.load(f)

print(patNum)
```

```{python}

#row bind all of the diff data for the different teeth
flatter = {}
for i in res["mainResults"].keys():
  aaa = res["mainResults"][i]["diffDat"]
  aaa["toothNum"] = i
  flatter[i] = aaa
fullDiffDat = pd.concat(flatter, axis = 0, ignore_index=True)
#manipulating the data
fullDiffDat["toothNum"] = pd.to_numeric(fullDiffDat["toothNum"])

#median table with absolute values
medDf = res["medianTable"]
medDf["toothNum"] = pd.to_numeric(medDf["toothNum"])

#plots for each direcional movement
absPlotX = (
  ggplot(fullDiffDat, aes(x = "toothNum", y = "absX", color = "toothNum")) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = .5, height = 0, width = .3) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = range(
      np.min(fullDiffDat["toothNum"]),
      np.max(fullDiffDat["toothNum"]) + 1,
      1
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend_position="none") +
  labs(
    title = "Absolute value of movement in X, " + patNum,
    y = "Abs. X",
    x = "Tooth Number",
    subtitle = "Medians plotted"
  ) +
  geom_point(data = medDf, mapping = aes(x = "toothNum", y = "medAbsX"), color = "red")
)
absPlotY = (
  ggplot(fullDiffDat, aes(x = "toothNum", y = "absY", color = "toothNum")) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = .5, height = 0, width = .3) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = range(
      np.min(fullDiffDat["toothNum"]),
      np.max(fullDiffDat["toothNum"]) + 1,
      1
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend_position="none") +
  labs(
    title = "Absolute value of movement in Y, " + patNum,
    y = "Abs. Y",
    x = "Tooth Number",
    subtitle = "Medians plotted"
  ) +
  geom_point(data = medDf, mapping = aes(x = "toothNum", y = "medAbsY"), color = "red")
)
absPlotZ = (
  ggplot(fullDiffDat, aes(x = "toothNum", y = "absZ", color = "toothNum")) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = .5, height = 0, width = .3) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = range(
      np.min(fullDiffDat["toothNum"]),
      np.max(fullDiffDat["toothNum"]) + 1,
      1
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend_position="none") +
  labs(
    title = "Absolute value of movement in Z, " + patNum,
    y = "Abs. Z",
    x = "Tooth Number",
    subtitle = "Median plotted"
  ) +
  geom_point(data = medDf, mapping = aes(x = "toothNum", y = "medAbsZ"), color = "red")
)
plotL2 = (
  ggplot(fullDiffDat, aes(x = "toothNum", y = "l2Norm", color = "toothNum")) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = .5, height = 0, width = .3) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = range(
      np.min(fullDiffDat["toothNum"]),
      np.max(fullDiffDat["toothNum"]) + 1,
      1
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend_position="none") +
  labs(
    title = "L2 norm of movement vector, " + patNum,
    y = "L2 Norm",
    x = "Tooth Number",
    subtitle = "Median plotted"
  ) +
  geom_point(data = medDf, mapping = aes(x = "toothNum", y = "medL2"), color = "red")
)
display(absPlotX)
display(absPlotY)
display(absPlotZ)
display(plotL2)
```
